title: Chapter 361
text:
This time, Gashley explained, "Don't worry, Black Star's people are all immortals."

"What?"

Goa was shocked. She did not understand Han Xiao's team before, but after hearing Gashley's explanation, she understood the uniqueness of the Black Star Mercenary. She murmured, "A bunch of immortals, no wonder they are qualified to be Ring's partners …"

This time, she did not try to persuade him anymore.

Han Xiao suddenly had an idea and said, "We only know that Floating Dragon Island is the location, but we don't know the identity of the scavenger or who he made a deal with. It will be like looking for a needle in a haystack. Do you have any other ideas?"

The Purple Gold Army clairvoyant shook his head, indicating that his divination could not find such a detailed thing.

Han Xiao was relieved. He coughed and pretended to say, "I'm also a clairvoyant. I just felt something and found some new clues."

Everyone was surprised and looked over.

Han Xiao remembered that he had the Destiny's Child Character Summon Card, and he still had five chances to use it. He asked, "If I provide reliable information, will there be any rewards?"

The Silver captain nodded. "Of course."

"I want to specify a reward."

"What do you want?"

"Mechanic advancement knowledge," Han Xiao said with a smile. This was a good chance to ask for something.

The Silvers discussed for a while and agreed to Han Xiao's request. In the Sea of Star Spirits, advancement knowledge was not that precious. It was basically a common item, and they could send it over just by talking to their friends. It did not even cost them money.

After getting the confirmation, Han Xiao used the Destiny's Child Card. His vision changed, and he entered a blurry scene. He saw some fragments.

After a while, his vision returned to normal. The Destiny's Child ability was very powerful. Han Xiao already knew the general appearance of the customer. He should be able to find the target by following the clues.

He reported the information, and the Silvers sent the designated advancement knowledge to his communicator.

Han Xiao learned it directly with his Potential Points, and the new knowledge entered his mind.

You have learned [Instant Dismantle and Reassemble]!

"This is the difference …" Han Xiao could not help but sigh. The knowledge that he could not learn in the Shattered Star Ring could be easily learned by the Silvers. This was the difference between civilizations. He almost wanted to kidnap these Silvers.

However, it was just a thought, and he quickly discarded this suicidal thought. Now that he had the foundation of a faction, he did not want to become a fugitive who was hunted down everywhere.

After completing the employment procedures, Han Xiao asked for the compression technology and the other two advanced knowledges. Seeing that Han Xiao was the leader, the Silvers all agreed. It was common for Supers to ask for new knowledges.

A mission was triggered on the interface. The basic reward was one of the Compressed Technology Knowledge. If he successfully rescued the hostages, he would be able to obtain another piece of knowledge. He would be rewarded with more than 4,000,000 experience points and some additional monetary rewards.

As for the players, their only reward was money.

After settling everything, there was no time to lose. Han Xiao and the others boarded the spaceship and followed the three mercenary groups to Floating Dragon Island.

…

Shattered Star Ring, unknown area, Dark-star base, video conference room. The upper echelons of the Dark-star organization had an emergency meeting.

"The carrier this time was robbed."

"Did Godora discover our plan?"

"No, this is just an accident. The carrier they chose this time was a Silver, and the one who robbed him was a slave trader."

"That's good. According to the intelligence, the location seems to be Floating Dragon Island. What should we do?"

"Send someone to rob the slave that was bought, find the carrier, and retrieve the goods. Outsiders don't have the password, so they won't be able to take out the Mutation Source and Super Gene Extractor. These two things cost the organization a lot of money. We can't afford to lose them."

"Then who should we send to carry out the mission?"

"This is a serious matter. Let [Ashes] go. Ever since he officially joined Dark-star, he has never failed."

Not long after, a stealth spaceship left Dark-star base and flew toward Floating Dragon Island.

…

"Only fifteen Silvers?"

They were already very close to Floating Dragon Island. Peggy contacted the customer again and learned of the other party's new request. There were seventeen Silvers on the spaceship, and there were still two that had not been sold. He thought about it and asked his subordinates to bring the two Silvers up. One of them was the carrier who called himself the messenger of Dark-star.

In front of the cabin door on the side of the spaceship, the two Silvers knelt in front of Peggy. The scavengers surrounded the two of them and looked like they were waiting for a good show.

"Open the door," Peggy said.

His subordinate opened the inner cabin door, and the outer cabin door was closed. The two Silvers saw this and guessed what the scavengers were going to do. They were shocked and started to struggle violently, but they were held down tightly.

Peggy nodded, and the other Silver was pushed out of the inner cabin door. Then, the inner cabin door closed, and the outer cabin door opened. This Silver's body was exposed to the vacuum, and he slowly floated out. His eyes were wide open, and he struggled for a while. The organs in his body were broken, and he died a horrible death.

"Hahaha …" The scavengers saw this through the window and laughed. This was the scavengers' entertainment.

The delivery Silver panicked and said, "Aren't you going to sell me? I'm worth a lot of money! I have a lot of money to redeem myself. Why do you want to kill me? "

Peggy's eyes were gloomy, and his face was twisted. "You're my goods. I can do whatever I want with you. I hate people bargaining with me, and I hate you superior races even more. Every time I see people like you, it reminds me of pure-blooded Godora bastards. All arrogant people deserve to die."

Then, he waved his hand, and his subordinate repeated the action and threw this Silver out. He died quickly in the vacuum.

Then, the spaceship accelerated and left this area. Only the two Silver bodies floated in the cold space.

…

At the same time, in another direction, the mercenary group's spaceship was about to land on Floating Dragon Island.

This was a continental plate sailing in the universe, like an interstellar island. There were many stabilizers and thrusters at the bottom. A translucent cover covered the entire floating island, maintaining the atmosphere and gravity.

The architectural style of Floating Dragon Island was rough, forming a city. Looking down from above, it looked like a giant dragon spreading its wings. Many mechanical excavators were fixed on the ground, and drills were used to collect the Void Dragon bones underground. This was a very expensive material.

Countless ferocious-looking modified spaceships with different logos were docked at the dock. They were all the spaceships of scavengers and space pirates. Among them, there were many notorious criminals, such as great pirates and scavengers with a bounty of more than 100,000.

The mercenary group's spaceship landed successfully. After the procedures were completed, they walked into the city together. There were extremely stubborn criminals everywhere on the streets.

The three mercenary groups were all wearing uniforms, which attracted a lot of attention. They attracted the attention of countless criminals.

The air was filled with hostility, making one's hair stand on end. Because they knew that danger was everywhere, they were fully armed on the spaceship. The players wore the Sunil soldier armor, and Han Xiao was equipped with Amphiptere.

The three mercenary groups had a wide range of businesses and had many enemies. Although these people looked at them with hatred, they were afraid of the reputation of the three mercenary groups and did not act rashly. However, Han Xiao and the others, who obviously did not belong to the three mercenary groups, attracted more attention.

Herlous frowned and said, "Black Star, I can feel the gazes of at least three Supers of the same level. They are looking at us as if they want to eat us."

Han Xiao laughed. "Of course. We are walking together with Ring, Blades, and Purple Gold. Those brutes will naturally turn their attention to us. Look, those guys are examples."

Looking in the direction of the finger, a group of galactic pirates leaned against the wall and pointed at them. Their eyes were filled with hostility. The pirate leader spat out a mouthful of thick phlegm, which stuck to Maple Moon's armor at the edge of the group.

"Then, aren't we in more danger?" Herlous was shocked.

"Do you know what it means to make the best use of everything?" Han Xiao laughed.

Before Herlous could react, Han Xiao suddenly bent his legs and charged toward the group of galactic pirates. Without a word, he extended his scythe and slashed.

The group of pirates did not expect this and immediately fired.

Ding ding ding

Sparks flew, and the bullets all bounced off the Amphiptere mechanical suit. Han Xiao was like a hot knife through butter. With a horizontal slash of his scythe, four pirates were cut in half. Blood splattered on the ground!

"You're looking for death!" The pirate leader was beside him. He was enraged. He took out an axe enchanted with flames and slashed it over. He was a Grade C Pugilist.

Han Xiao clenched his fist, and the axe was tightly held, unable to move an inch. He swung his scythe, and the scythe turned into a magnetic chain electric blade, binding the pirate leader's body like a whip. He directly activated Flaming Will, and the scythe shrunk.

Swoosh!

The pirate leader's health bar was instantly emptied. He did not even make a sound before he was cut into pieces!

Herlous was dumbfounded.
